svg.text: Pico W + BTT TMC2226 (X axis MCU)
X-left: STEP=GPIO11, DIR=GPIO10, EN=GPIO12, UART=GPIO9, endstop=GPIO4.
X-right: STEP=GPIO7, DIR=GPIO6, EN=GPIO8, UART=GPIO5, endstop=GPIO22.
SFS left: SWITCH=GPIO0, MOTION=GPIO1. SFS right: SWITCH=GPIO2, MOTION=GPIO3.
CR Touch: CONTROL=GPIO13, Z_SIGNAL=GPIO14 open-drain with Pico internal pull-up; 5V power only.
